sources_considered.why: Primary manufacturer discussion of continuing usefulness of older hardware. Contextual counterevidence, not a 2030 outcome.
Secondary discussion; the primary NVIDIA disclosure was preferred.
End of support for particular software branches does not establish commercial obsolescence of the specified GPU cohort.

evidence_items.locator: Durable: The Installed Base Keeps Earning

receipt.public_excerpt: Not every workload needs the newest system.

evidence_items.explanation: NVIDIA describes continued commercial service for A100 hardware introduced in 2020 and explains how older generations retain workloads. This challenges automatic obsolescence from newer releases, but concerns other cohorts and does not establish the named buyers' position in 2030.

unresolved_gaps: The deadline is still in the future.
No qualifying irreversible event affecting almost the entire specified cohort was identified.
Purchase-cohort inventories and a numerical meaning of near-complete obsolescence are missing.
